text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
A pimple!? For real!? No, no, no, no, nooo 
way~~!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I can't run in front of people like 
this... Training is like, totally out of 
the question...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
My only option now is to take a break... 
"Got a pimple, so it's a no-go"... and 
send.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora's motivation seems to 
have dropped because of her skin breakout.
